# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Strong directional volume bias within the first 30 minutes predicts sustained intraday movement. This edge exists because institutional order flow often imbalances early in the session, creating persistent pressure that retail-driven mean reversion fails to absorb.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the opening range (first 30-min bar) high-low exceeds ATR(5) AND cumulative up-tick volume ≥60% of total volume in that range AND the 30-min bar closes above VWAP, enter long at the bar’s close. Exit: Chart-stop at the opening range low, TP1 at 1.5× risk (distance from entry to stop), runner trail 15% off highest-watermark after TP1 hit. Regime filters: VIX < 20, time 09:30-10:00, avoid major news releases.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and min 3-contract size.
2. **Sample bias:** Zero historical samples tested; proposal based purely on conceptual novelty. High overfit risk without Stage-1 validation.

4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic simulator validation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw opening range followed by reversal (e.g., strong up-volume then down-day). Max drawdown: consecutive losing days in low-volume chop. Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion (VIX > 30) invalidating volume bias premise.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days drive >100% of P&L, state percentage).
